checks.name: planter_version
checks.description: Errors when the planter running the checks is older than the minimum version these checks need (planter_too_old).

checks.name: gn_secondary_tree
checks.description: Rejects Bazel files/deps in //build/secondary/ and MODULE.bazel repositories over current-layout third_party code (bazel_build_in_gn_secondary_tree, bazel_dep_on_gn_secondary_tree, repository_for_current_layout_third_party).

checks.name: migration_sanity
checks.description: Checks sentinel sync, @bazel2gn:skip rules, unexported new_local_repository build_file sources, truncated/unlinked working-tree build files, targetless BUILD.bazel files, duplicated srcs/hdrs headers, disconnected zero-rdep packages, and //docs/ includecode region tags (skipped_convertible_target, unjustified_test_skip, redundant_bazel2gn_skip, unexported_local_repository_file, unnecessary_manual_tag, corrupted_working_tree_build_file, empty_build_bazel, disconnected_zero_rdep_package_migrated, includecode_region_tag_removed, header_duplicated_in_srcs_and_hdrs).

checks.name: empty_gn_targets
checks.description: Flags GN groups (including forwarding groups in ancestor BUILD.gn files) and BUILD.gn files that the change leaves empty, so migrations delete them and their references instead of leaving stubs; groups with a `# Intentionally empty: <reason>` comment are exempt (empty_gn_group, empty_gn_build_file).

checks.name: gn_dep_parity
checks.description: Checks GN dep labels, link deps, public_deps configs, and unreferenced added Rust crate deps (dep_label_removed, dep_label_substituted, dep_link_settings_dropped, unexpected_rust_dep_added).

checks.name: gn_attr_parity
checks.description: Checks GN-only attrs, output names, and local #include headers (gn_only_attr_dropped, undeclared_cc_local_header).

checks.name: gn_target_type_parity
checks.description: Checks GN templates: alwayslink, test vs executable, LTO config (source_set_without_alwayslink, test_became_executable, cc_test_executable_lost_lto_config, host_test_lost; INFO test_became_cc_test_executable, executable_became_cc_test_executable).

checks.name: visibility_audit
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel visibility via find_rdeps, restricted rust_crates allowlists, and cross-package dep access (overbroad_public_visibility, visibility_narrowed, redundant_covered_visibility_entry, visibility_widened_beyond_gn, missing_rust_crates_visibility, inaccessible_cross_package_dep).

checks.name: build_only_scope
checks.description: Blocks non-build source edits except allowed test .cml or README labels, flags unfinished git rebase/merge conflict states, and blocks unconditional GN pre-build deps on global Bazel host build entrypoints (non_build_file_modified, unfinished_git_operation, unconditional_host_gn_prebuild).

checks.name: lint_config_parity
checks.description: Flags lint-silencing source edits, Rust edition downgrades or unrequested legacy/safety lint overrides, and custom lint_config missing defaults (lint_driven_source_edit, rust_edition_downgrade).

checks.name: shared_config_reuse
checks.description: Flags lint_config alias wrappers, copied lint dicts, and duplicated declare_args (alias_obscures_config, duplicated_default_lints, inline_gn_declare_args).

checks.name: bazel_minimality
checks.description: Audits Starlark wrapper rules, symbolic macro attrs, IDK atom allowlists, default attrs, host constraints, and buildifier (unwrapped_external_language_rule, unsupported_fx_component_attribute, missing_idk_atom_allowlist, transitive_legacy_host_constraints, buildifier_lint, invalid_todo_format, cc_binary_raw_output_name_annotation, rustc_test_raw_output_name_annotation, rustc_staticlib_raw_public_annotation).

checks.name: confidentiality_check
checks.description: Blocks internal vendor paths, domains, emails, handles, and names (confidentiality_violation).

checks.name: gn_format
checks.description: Checks the GN prebuilt matches the pinned revision and runs `gn format --dry-run` on added or modified GN files (stale_gn_prebuilt, gn_format, gn_syntax_error).

checks.name: bazel_shac_lint
checks.description: Runs scripts/shac/bazel_lint rules on modified Starlark files (category is the shac rule name).

checks.name: commit_message_format
checks.description: Validates commit subject/body format, line lengths, footers, test-parity footers (Renamed-Tests:, Skipped-Dual-Tests:, forbidden Deleted-Tests:/Build-Only:), NO_IFTTT lines, and premature pre-upload Git commits (commit_subject_format, commit_subject_overstates_migration, commit_subject_broad_tag, missing_bazel_migration_target_footer, agent_added_no_ifttt, premature_pre_upload_git_commit).

checks.name: test_data_attribute
checks.description: Flags test-only fixtures in `data` (test_only_data_in_data), host test data in `data` of host_rustc_test (host_test_data_in_data), attribute-level `@bazel2gn:skip` on `test_data` of unskipped host tests (skipped_test_data_attr_on_host_test), runtime test fixtures in `compile_data` (runtime_test_data_in_compile_data), unreferenced `test_data` targets (unused_test_data), undocumented omitted GN `host_test_data` entries (undocumented_omitted_host_test_data), GN `$root_build_dir` host_test_data/copy outputs colliding across variant toolchains (host_test_data_root_build_dir_outputs, unguarded_root_build_dir_outputs), runtime `.exists()` fallback probing (runtime_test_data_path_probing), and unskipped GN host tests missing staged test data (dual_build_test_data_fallback_dropped).

checks.name: test_suite_layout
checks.description: Enforces two-tier Bazel test_suite() and GN bazel_test_suite() layout, explicit tests = [...] lists, upward aggregation flow, host-configuration test_suite() compatibility, and human review when expanding an existing empty test_suite() (per_package_bazel_test_suite, bazel_test_suite_only_build_gn, nested_test_suite, implicit_test_suite, expanded_empty_test_suite, upward_bazel_test_suite_ref, fuchsia_target_in_host_test_suite).

checks.name: build_verification
checks.description: Runs `fx build`, GN rdeps, `fx lint`, `fx bazel build`, and host tests (build_failure_<step>, preexisting_failure_<step>).

checks.name: tests_json_parity
checks.description: Verifies <build dir>/tests.json parity across GN-to-Bazel migrations via verify_tests_json_parity.py across product roots and off-CQ developer leaf groups, enforcing Case 1/Case 2/Case 3 variant transitions, attribute parity, and 1:1 Renamed-Tests: bijections (test_dropped_from_tests_json).

checks.name: speculative_unit_test
checks.description: Rejects empty unit tests, unrequested host test wrappers, and no-op with_unit_tests TODOs (speculative_empty_unit_test, redundant_empty_unit_test_todo).

checks.name: cc_header_deps_and_annotations
checks.description: Requires comments on new @bazel2gn directives, disable_build_flags TODOs on rustc_* configs -= directives, TODO(https://fxbug.dev/582031294) on cc_*_library_zx raw_attribute directives, LINT.IfChange guards on inlined file lists, preserved multi-line BUILD.gn explanatory comments and translated commented-out attributes on migrated targets, non-redundant BUILD.gn comments, public header deps in `deps`, upstream in-tree C/C++ headers declared in `hdrs`, unskipped non-duplicated `hdrs` on C/C++ library rules, and removal of unused C/C++ deps that puncture restricted upstream visibility (undocumented_bazel2gn_directive, rustc_configs_remove_missing_todo, zx_library_raw_attribute_missing_todo, inlined_file_list_missing_ifttt, dropped_gn_comment_block, redundant_gn_comment_block, untranslated_gn_commented_attr, orphaned_test_env_todo_on_library, undeclared_upstream_cc_header, redundant_builtin_label_directive, redundant_hdrs_bazel2gn_skip, duplicate_header_in_srcs_and_hdrs, unused_cc_dep_visibility_puncture).

checks.name: package_boundary_labels
checks.description: Flags ancestor BUILD.bazel files naming files under a newly added Bazel package by relative path (crossed_package_boundary).

checks.name: owners_allowlist_scope
checks.description: Verifies mirrored Starlark allowlist dict entries stay in OWNERS-gated subdirectories matching their GN group definitions (owners_scoped_allowlist_misplaced).

checks.name: idk_attributes
checks.description: Checks that idk_cc_* targets set api_area, and correctly map deps to implementation_deps when no_headers is true, and that GN runtime_deps survive migration unchanged (runtime_deps_dropped; WARNING runtime_dep_promoted_to_link_dep).

checks.name: macro_api_parity
checks.description: Enforces bazel/style/rules_macros.md on changed .bzl files (configurable symbolic macro attrs, non-None-default None comparisons, _impl defaults and naming, docstrings, keyword-only args, legacy macro visibility, kwargs extraction, target name variables, fx_ prefix, antipatterns), verifies loaded macro/function call kwargs, and audits package rules and GN templates for drift (macro_redeclares_inherited_attr, macro_configurable_attr_misuse, macro_non_none_default_none_compare, macro_impl_default_arg, rule_or_macro_impl_name, missing_bzl_documentation, bzl_docstring_concat, bzl_public_func_positional_defaults, legacy_macro_missing_target_visibility, macro_kwargs_attr_extraction, macro_inline_target_name_duplication, bzl_fuchsia_prefix_outside_sdk, bzl_antipattern, starlark_call_unexpected_kwarg, starlark_call_missing_kwarg, package_macro_duplicates_plumbing, bootfs_package_shared_lib_merkle_conflict, unexplained_no_gn_equivalent, gn_template_crate_name_not_forwarded).

checks.name: machinery_script_lint
checks.description: Audits active $PLANTER_PROJECT_DIR and modified repo planter shell/Python scripts, inline Python heredocs, and JSON manifests for syntax errors, undefined names/helper imports, module-level and function-local use-before-assignment, uncalled top-level check_* functions, duplicate function/class definitions, and duplicate dict keys (machinery_shell_syntax_error, machinery_python_syntax_error, machinery_undefined_python_name, machinery_python_use_before_def, machinery_uncalled_check_function, machinery_duplicate_python_def, machinery_duplicate_dict_key, machinery_json_syntax_error).

checks.name: cq_reachability
checks.description: Verifies tests reach group("tests"), umbrella ffx_plugin test sections/comments, and aggregation test_suite(), and HEAD stacks cleanly without squashing prerequisite commits onto origin/main or composite dependency stack refs (unexported_bazel_test, stale_plugin_tests_aggregation_comment, ungrouped_migrated_plugin_tests, unrebased_composite_stack, squashed_prerequisite_commit, unstacked_depends_on_commit, prerequisite_bazel_targets_overwritten, upstream_rebase_conflict).

checks.name: cutover_consistency
checks.description: On a GN-to-Bazel package cutover, builds both packages and compares contents and the x64 and arm64 build commands; records both packages in phase 1 and compares the Bazel package with the recorded GN package again in the final phase (INFO cutover_diff_<kind>, cutover_summary, cutover_info_<kind>).

checks.name: cutover_scope
checks.description: On a GN-to-Bazel package cutover, flags edits outside the package's logical group (INFO cutover_scope_outside_group).

checks.name: py_library_data_package
checks.description: Verifies py_library, py_binary, and py_binary_host_tool targets migrated from GN python_library/python_binary with data_package_name/data_sources stage <data_package_name>/__init__.py (via write_file in srcs) and data files (via copy_file in data, with is_executable = True for executable targets) and retain GN raw_attribute parity in dual builds, and verifies py_zipapp_binary retains native data_package_name/data_sources parity (py_library_missing_data_package_init, py_library_missing_data_source, py_library_data_copy_not_executable, py_library_gn_data_package_dropped, py_zipapp_missing_data_package, py_zipapp_missing_data_source).
